action_instruction: Inspecting each displayed request row in the Acme inbox
intent: PRIMARY: Inspect each displayed request row in the resulting Acme inbox
rationale: The sole displayed request row visibly includes Planned status, 12 votes, and age 14 minutes ago.

action_instruction: Checking status visibility on displayed request rows
intent: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible nonempty status control

action_params.condition: Every displayed request row shows a status.
action_params.query: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible nonempty status control
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows=Array.from(el(30).querySelectorAll(':scope > li')).filter(r => { const s=getComputedStyle(r); return s.display!=="none" && s.visibility!=="hidden"; }); return rows.length>0 && rows.every(r => { const status=r.querySelector(':scope > [role="combobox"]'); return !!status && status.textContent.trim().length>0 && getComputedStyle(status).display!=="none" && getComputedStyle(status).visibility!=="hidden"; }); })()

action_instruction: Checking vote count visibility on displayed request rows
intent: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible numeric vote count

action_params.condition: Every displayed request row shows a vote count.
action_params.query: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible numeric vote count
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows=Array.from(el(30).querySelectorAll(':scope > li')).filter(r => { const s=getComputedStyle(r); return s.display!=="none" && s.visibility!=="hidden"; }); return rows.length>0 && rows.every(r => { const vote=Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(':scope > span')).find(s => /^\d+$/.test(s.textContent.trim()) && s.className.includes("rounded-md")); return !!vote && getComputedStyle(vote).display!=="none" && getComputedStyle(vote).visibility!=="hidden"; }); })()

action_instruction: Checking age visibility on displayed request rows
intent: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible age label

action_params.condition: Every displayed request row shows an age.
action_params.query: whether every displayed request row in the Posts list has a visible age label
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows=Array.from(el(30).querySelectorAll(':scope > li')).filter(r => { const s=getComputedStyle(r); return s.display!=="none" && s.visibility!=="hidden"; }); return rows.length>0 && rows.every(r => { const age=Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(':scope > span')).find(s => /^\d+\s+(minute|minutes|hour|hours|day|days|week|weeks|month|months|year|years)\s+ago$/.test(s.textContent.trim())); return !!age && getComputedStyle(age).display!=="none" && getComputedStyle(age).visibility!=="hidden"; }); })()

assertion_tree.description: every row shows a status, vote count and age
